details: Every dually shattered set is dually antipodally shattered. The full cube makes the comparison strict: $\mathrm{VC}^{*a}=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ whereas $\mathrm{VC}^{*}=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$.
proof: For each labeling, ordinary dual shattering supplies a point inducing that labeling itself, which is one of the two patterns allowed by dual antipodal shattering.
name: Dual Antipodal VC Dimension / Dual VC Dimension
